source.format: gzip of whitespace-separated SRC DST UNIXTS, no header

license_and_use.local_use: authorized local doctoral research in this run
license_and_use.redistribution: not authorized by this run; raw archives and per-entity derived arrays remain local
license_and_use.license_inference: none; do not infer a dataset license from SNAP software licensing or public download availability

selection_rule.selection: earliest chronological episode with legal origins in every floor-based 70/10/20 split; no activity or model-score ranking

counts.source: SNAP email-Eu-core-temporal; same source as primary email regime
counts.claim_scope: within-source coverage-conditioned temporal supplement; not an independent dataset/source confirmation
counts.bin_convention: half-open [b*86400,(b+1)*86400); preserve original days; no time compression
counts.input_mask_semantics: all true for released-bin counts; source zero is an observed count zero, not an assertion of real-world absence

decision_roles.future_checkpoint_and_scheduler_calibrat: validation [368,420) only; not performed during preparation
decision_roles.test: [420,526); no predictions or model metrics accessed during source coverage selection/preparation; metrics only after future freeze

test_metrics_access: none during source coverage selection or bundle preparation; no model predictions or test metrics read
test_policy: test partition is not accessed for preprocessing statistics, parameter selection, or checkpoint/scheduler calibration
temporal_limit: Within-source supplement; selected by a source-coverage rule after observing the primary validation gap; not an independent dataset or external replication.
